title: Average, but cooks well!
text:
Average, but cooks well!. [[VIDEOID:b50d86429c004eb6a010886b8ca2962d]] This slow cooker is a nice 5 quart cooker. I like the stainless steel and black. The glass top is nice too. So why 3 stars? Three stars is a good average rating. Minus one star for no on light. Minus one star for no hour settings. This does work well and is easy to use and clean.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
